passifs.Ash: Bleed effects inflicted on enemies do 25% increased damage and last 50% longer.
passifs.Ash Prime: Bleed effects inflicted on enemies do 25% increased damage and last 50% longer.
passifs.Atlas: Becomes immune to Knockdown effects while on the ground.
passifs.Atlas Prime: Becomes immune to Knockdown effects while on the ground.
passifs.Banshee: Banshee pierces the ears of enemies within a 20m radius when casting Abilities, applying max <DT_PUNCTURE_COLOR>Puncture Status Effect. Additionally, Banshee's weapon noise is hushed.
passifs.Banshee Prime: Banshee pierces the ears of enemies within a 20m radius when casting Abilities, applying max <DT_PUNCTURE_COLOR>Puncture Status Effect. Additionally, Banshee's weapon noise is hushed.
passifs.Baruuk: Each projectile dodged, each enemy lulled or disarmed, erodes Baruuk's restraint and fuels the storm within. As Baruuk's restraint is diminished he becomes up to 50% more resistant to damage.
passifs.Baruuk Prime: Each projectile dodged, each enemy lulled or disarmed, erodes Baruuk's restraint and fuels the storm within. As Baruuk's restraint is diminished he becomes up to 50% more resistant to damage.
passifs.Caliban: Allies within Affinity range gain increased resistance to the types of damage they are currently taking.
passifs.Caliban Prime: Allies within Affinity range gain increased resistance to the types of damage they are currently taking.
passifs.Chroma: Wings sprout for an additional jump and bullet jump.
passifs.Chroma Prime: Wings sprout for an additional jump and bullet jump.
passifs.Citrine: Citrine grants nearby allies 5 health regeneration per second. Pick up a Health Orb to increase regeneration by 0.1, up to a maximum of 25.
passifs.Citrine Prime: Citrine grants nearby allies 5 health regeneration per second. Pick up a Health Orb to increase regeneration by 0.1, up to a maximum of 25.
passifs.Cyte-09: Weak Point Kills increase Cyte-09's Weak Point Critical Chance by 1% up to 300% for the duration of the current mission.
passifs.Dagath: There is a 35% chance that Energy and Health Orbs will be 300% more effective on Dagath.
passifs.Dante: Noctua scans targets, recording information for your Codex. Status Chance increases by 50% on fully scanned targets.
passifs.Ember: Receive 5% Ability Strength for every enemy within Affinity Range affected by Heat.
passifs.Ember Prime: Receive 5% Ability Strength for every enemy within Affinity Range affected by Heat.
passifs.Equinox: 10% of Health Orbs are converted into Energy, and 10% of Energy Orbs are converted into Health.
passifs.Equinox Prime: 10% of Health Orbs are converted into Energy, and 10% of Energy Orbs are converted into Health.
passifs.Excalibur: Excalibur deals 10% increased damage and attacks 10% faster when wielding swords.
passifs.Excalibur Prime: Excalibur Prime deals 10% increased damage and attacks 10% faster when wielding swords.
passifs.Excalibur Umbra: Umbra exhibits sentience in combat without Transference control. Attacks 10% faster and deals 10% more damage while wielding swords.
passifs.Excalibur Umbra Prime: Excalibur deals 10% increased damage and attacks 10% faster when wielding swords.
passifs.Follie: INKBLOT: Follie's abilities coat enemies in ink that slows their movement by 50% for 10s. Afflicted enemies have a 20% chance to drop Health and Energy Orbs.
passifs.Frost: Cold Status Effects from Frost's Abilities last 100% longer. Frost gains 50 Armor per enemy afflicted with Cold Status within Affinity Range.
passifs.Frost Prime: Cold Status Effects from Frost's Abilities last 100% longer. Frost gains 50 Armor per enemy afflicted with Cold Status within Affinity Range.
passifs.Gara: A chance to create a radial blind lasting 10s when Gara casts abilities.
passifs.Gara Prime: A chance to create a radial blind lasting 10s when exposed to bright light.
passifs.Garuda: Garuda's damage temporarily increases with each enemy she kills, to a maximum of 100%. Slashes with her talons if no melee weapon is equipped.
passifs.Garuda Prime: Garuda's damage temporarily increases with each enemy she kills, to a maximum of 100%. Slashes with her talons if no melee weapon is equipped.
passifs.Gauss: Moving generates an electrical current that fills Gauss' battery. Shields recharge up to 120% faster while the Recharge Delay is up to 80% shorter, based on the battery level.
passifs.Gauss Prime: Moving generates an electrical current that fills Gauss' battery. Shields recharge up to 120% faster while the Recharge Delay is up to 80% shorter, based on the battery level.
passifs.Grendel: Each enemy consumed grants 250 bonus armor.
passifs.Grendel Prime: Each enemy consumed grants 250 bonus armor.
passifs.Gyre: Gyre's abilities have a 10% chance to deal critical damage for each Electrical status that affects the enemy.
passifs.Gyre Prime: Gyre's abilities have a 10% chance to deal critical damage for each Electrical status that affects the enemy.
passifs.Harrow: Overshield capacity doubled. Start missions at maximum energy.
passifs.Harrow Prime: Overshield capacity doubled. Start missions at maximum energy.
passifs.Hildryn: Hildryn's full Shield Gate is high. After her Shields are depleted, she is invulnerable to damage up to 3.5s.
passifs.Hildryn Prime: Hildryn's full Shield Gate is high. After her Shields are depleted, she is invulnerable to damage up to 3.5s.
passifs.Hydroid: Enemies damaged by Hydroid are more vulnerable to Corrosion Status, with initial status reducing armor by 50%.
passifs.Hydroid Prime: Enemies damaged by Hydroid are more vulnerable to Corrosion Status, with initial status reducing armor by 50%.
passifs.Inaros: When Inaros takes lethal damage, he entombs himself in a sarcophagus and incarnates as sand to attack enemies, draining their lifeforce to revive himself.
passifs.Inaros Prime: When Inaros takes lethal damage, he entombs himself in a sarcophagus and incarnates as sand to attack enemies, draining their lifeforce to revive himself.
passifs.Jade: Jade's profound understanding of the relationship between life and death grants her two Aura Mod Slots. Some of her Abilities apply Judgments, increasing enemy damage vulnerability by 50% for 10s.
passifs.Khora: The ferocious kavat, Venari, fights by Khora's side and provides her with a 15% speed boost while active. If killed, Venari will reappear after 45s.
passifs.Khora Prime: The ferocious kavat, Venari, fights by Khora Prime's side and provides her with a 15% speed boost while active. If killed, Venari will reappear after 45s.
passifs.Koumei: Every 60 seconds, one of Koumei's weapons will inflict random Status Effects for 60 seconds
passifs.Kullervo: Kullervo boasts +75% Heavy Attack Efficiency and +100% Heavy Attack Wind Up Speed on all melee weapons.
passifs.Lavos: Energy and Universal Orbs give Lavos status immunity for 10s. Hold any ability to imbue the next cast with additional Elemental Damage and Status.
passifs.Lavos Prime: Energy and Universal Orbs give Lavos status immunity for 10s. Hold any ability to imbue the next cast with additional Elemental Damage and Status.
passifs.Limbo: Dodge to enter and exit the Rift. Entering leaves behind a small Rift portal lasting 5s. Energy slowly recharges in the Rift, and each enemy killed in there also gives 10 Energy.
passifs.Limbo Prime: Dodge to enter and exit the Rift. Entering leaves behind a small Rift portal lasting 5s. Energy slowly recharges in the Rift, and each enemy killed in there also gives 10 Energy.
passifs.Loki: Able to hang from walls 10x longer than normal.
passifs.Loki Prime: Able to hang from walls 10x longer than normal.
passifs.Mag: Nearby items gravitate towards Mag for easy collection.
passifs.Mag Prime: Nearby items gravitate towards Mag for easy collection.
passifs.Mesa: Shoot dual-wielded sidearms 15% faster and reload single-handed sidearms 25% more rapidly. Gain 50 Bonus Health when not using Melee Weapons.
passifs.Mesa Prime: Shoot dual-wielded sidearms 15% faster and reload single-handed sidearms 25% more rapidly. Gain 50 Bonus Health when not using Melee Weapons.
passifs.Mirage: Sliding lasts 85% longer and acrobatic maneuvers are 50% faster.
passifs.Mirage Prime: Sliding lasts 85% longer and acrobatic maneuvers are 50% faster.
passifs.Narin: Each stack of <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold Status Effect on enemies increase chance to spawn Sangodae pickup by 1%, granting <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Extra Cold Damage on Primary and Secondary weapons for 10s. Narin also gains Cold Damage for her abilities.
passifs.Nekros: Restore 5 Health with every enemy death within 10m.
passifs.Nekros Prime: Restore 5 Health with every enemy death within 10m.
passifs.Nidus: If Nidus is killed with at least 15 stacks of Mutation, those 15 stacks are consumed; this grants 5s of invulnerability and restores Health to 50%.
passifs.Nidus Prime: If Nidus is killed with at least 15 stacks of Mutation, those 15 stacks are consumed; this grants 5s of invulnerability and restores Health to 50%.
passifs.Nokko: Upon receiving fatal damage, Nokko reverts to his Sprodling form and his active mushrooms will glow, reviving Nokko when touched. Orbs spawned will grant a speed boost but not healing. If a glowing mushroom is not reached in time, Nokko will automatically use a self-revive.
passifs.Nova: Enemies killed while slowed down have 15% to drop health orbs. Enemies killed while sped up have 15% to drop energy orbs.
passifs.Nova Prime: Enemies killed while slowed down have 15% to drop health orbs. Enemies killed while sped up have 15% to drop energy orbs.
passifs.Nyx: Nyx gains +40% Critical Chance on Primary and Secondary weapons per confused enemy within Affinity Range, up to +200%.
passifs.Nyx Prime: Nyx gains +40% Critical Chance on Primary and Secondary weapons per confused enemy within Affinity Range, up to +200%.
passifs.Oberon: Oberon grants Righteous Negation to himself and his allies in <AFFINITY_SHARE>Affinity Range when he collects <HEALTH>Health Orbs, protecting players against the next instance of damage. Stacks up to 3 times.
passifs.Oberon Prime: Oberon grants Righteous Negation to himself and his allies in <AFFINITY_SHARE>Affinity Range when he collects <HEALTH>Health Orbs, protecting players against the next instance of damage. Stacks up to 3 times.
passifs.Octavia: Replenish 30 energy over 30s for Octavia and allies within 15m when abilities are activated.
passifs.Octavia Prime: Replenish 30 energy over 30s for Octavia and allies within 15m when abilities are activated.
passifs.Oraxia: Wall Latching grants Predator's Lurk, rendering Oraxia invisible for 8s.
passifs.Orion: Swapping between them grants 45% Ability Efficiency for the next 2 casts. When below 50 energy, Sirius & Orion will steal energy from each other.
passifs.Protea: Every 4th Power Cast is granted +100% Ability Strength.
passifs.Protea Prime: Every 4th Power Cast is granted +100% Ability Strength.
passifs.Qorvex: Weapons wield by Qorvex have an additional +3 Punch Through.
passifs.Revenant: Shield depletion smashes enemies within 7.5m with a 100 Damage knockdown shockwave.
passifs.Revenant Prime: Shield depletion smashes enemies within 7.5m with a 100 Damage knockdown shockwave.
passifs.Rhino: Emit a shockwave dealing 100 damage after landing from a great height.
passifs.Rhino Prime: Emit a shockwave dealing 100 damage after landing from a great height.
passifs.Saryn: Status Effects inflicted upon enemies last 25% longer.
passifs.Saryn Prime: Status Effects inflicted upon enemies last 25% longer.
passifs.Sevagoth: On death, become Sevagoth's Shadow and fight to resurrect him by collecting the souls needed to rebuild his tombstone.
passifs.Sevagoth Prime: On death, become Sevagoth's Shadow and fight to resurrect him by collecting the souls needed to rebuild his tombstone.
passifs.Sirius: Swapping between them grants 45% Ability Efficiency for the next 2 casts. When below 50 energy, Sirius & Orion will steal energy from each other.
passifs.Sirius & Orion: Swapping between them grants 45% Ability Efficiency for the next 2 casts. When below 50 energy, Sirius & Orion will steal energy from each other.
passifs.Stalker: Stalker's attacks have +300% Critical Chance against enemies who do not see him.
passifs.Styanax: Styanax's critical chance increases with his shields and doubles for spearguns.
passifs.Styanax Prime: Styanax's critical chance increases with his shields and doubles for spearguns.
passifs.Temple: Play abilities in sync with the Backbeat metronome to invigorate ability effects while increasing Ability Efficiency by 50%.
passifs.Titania: Titania generates Health for herself and nearby allies every time she casts an Ability.
passifs.Titania Prime: Titania generates Health for herself and nearby allies every time she casts an Ability.
passifs.Trinity: Allies in Affinity Range gain 50% of Trinity's Max Energy as Health.
passifs.Trinity Prime: Allies in Affinity Range gain 50% of Trinity's Max Energy as Health.
passifs.Uriel: Uriel commands, empowers, and protects three unique demons. CATENACH: Snares and slows enemies chaining them together. Damage dealt to any target in the chain is inflicted on all snared enemies. (Unlocks with Infernalis) GULPHAGOR : Latches onto foes dealing damage over time. If killed, a circle of pain is spawned. (Unlocks with Remedium) VYTHELAS: Inscribes demonic runes upon fallen foes that add Fire Rate and <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage when collected. (Unlocks with Demonium)
passifs.Valkyr: Valkyr accumulates Rage when hitting or killing enemies with melee weapons, increasing her Melee Damage up to 300%. Taking fatal damage when the Rage meter is above 150% consumes the meter, preventing death and granting 5s of invulnerability.
passifs.Valkyr Prime: Valkyr accumulates Rage when hitting or killing enemies with melee weapons, increasing her Melee Damage up to 300%. Taking fatal damage when the Rage meter is above 150% consumes the meter, preventing death and granting 5s of invulnerability.
passifs.Vauban: Deal 25% Extra Damage to incapacitated enemies.
passifs.Vauban Prime: Deal 25% Extra Damage to incapacitated enemies.
passifs.Volt: Grounded movement generates an electrical charge building up 1000 Damage per meter that is unleashed with the next attack.
passifs.Volt Prime: Grounded movement generates an electrical charge building up 1000 Damage per meter that is unleashed with the next attack.
passifs.Voruna: Voruna never fights alone. In mission, hold Abilities to call upon each wolf's unique Passive power.
passifs.Voruna Prime: Voruna never fights alone. In mission, hold Abilities to call upon each wolf's unique Passive power.
passifs.Wisp: Flowing between dimensions Wisp becomes invisible to enemies while in the air.
passifs.Wisp Prime: Flowing between dimensions Wisp becomes invisible to enemies while in the air.
passifs.Wukong: After taking fatal damage Wukong automatically uses one of his mastered survival techniques. These techniques can only be invoked three times per mission.
passifs.Wukong Prime: After taking fatal damage Wukong automatically uses one of his mastered survival techniques. These techniques can only be invoked three times per mission.
passifs.Xaku: 25% Damage Reduction on AOE attacks and chance to avoid incoming weapon damage.
passifs.Xaku Prime: 25% Damage Reduction on AOE attacks and chance to avoid incoming weapon damage.
passifs.Yareli: Yareli gains +200% Critical Chance for Secondary weapons when she has been moving for at least 1.5s.
passifs.Yareli Prime: Yareli gains +200% Critical Chance for Secondary weapons when she has been moving for at least 1.5s.
passifs.Zephyr: Zephyr moves faster and falls slower while airborne. Also gain 150% Critical Hit chance with weapons while airborne.
passifs.Zephyr Prime: Zephyr moves faster and falls slower while airborne. Also gain 150% Critical Hit chance with weapons while airborne.
